The collection

Made simple, worn often

Almora began with one idea: a wardrobe should feel easy. We keep our palette soft, our fabrics comfortable and our cuts clean, so a blazer dress for the office and a floral maxi for the weekend sit happily in the same cupboard.

Every piece is made in small batches with natural fabrics like cotton, linen and viscose.
